principle: A cadet schedule is a persistent plan of expected commitments over real time. It constrains where a cadet should be, but does not overwrite authoritative actual-presence World State.
rules: Schedules consume existing Academy population slots and never create cadets.
Latent and materialized cadets may hold schedules because schedule identity is anchored to population_slot_ref.
Materialization cannot reroll a valid existing schedule.
Shared academic commitments must remain synchronized for all members assigned to that commitment.
Fixed commitments cannot overlap for the same cadet.
Flexible required obligations may move only inside their authored allowed windows.
Travel between different locations consumes nonzero configured/derived time when locations are not co-located.
Impossible transfer time creates an explicit schedule conflict instead of teleportation or silent time rewriting.
Protected medical/accessibility/personal windows are explicit constraints; species or personality alone never create them.
The player follows the same schedule feasibility rules as NPC cadets.
Schedule states expected activity/location; authoritative current_location remains separate runtime truth.
Being absent or late does not retroactively alter what the schedule required.
Uncommitted intervals are exposed as available temporal capacity but Step 5 does not choose how they are used.
Free time, clubs, social life, romance, wellbeing consequences, discipline and off-screen execution remain later steps.
Schedule changes require explicit revision/exception events and prior schedule versions remain historical.
Campus events may create explicit obligation/conflict/revision candidates, but never silently rewrite a valid schedule.
Authorized crisis preemption remains a schedule-revision candidate until authoritative execution applies it.
